feedback.card.body: Your marks stay on this device and are never sent anywhere. If you wish, you can export them as a file and send it to the maintainers to help improve the app.
feedback.card.title: Your feedback
feedback.export.answers: Also include my answers (symptoms and profile)
feedback.export.answers.hint: Off by default. It helps the maintainers understand your marks, but it is health information.
feedback.export.title: Export feedback
feedback.export.warning: The file lists your marks and a summary of the result they refer to. It is saved only to your device and is not uploaded; you decide whether to send it to anyone.
feedback.question: Did this match your experience?
